rows.subject: Deadline for withdrawal of a suspended European Digital Identity Wallet
rows.previous: Previous edition: 'if the compromise remains unremedied for more than 6 months'
rows.finding: Correct: THREE months. The wording reads 'not remedied within three months of the suspension'. Identical to Article 10(3) for electronic identification schemes.

rows.subject: Maximum administrative fines
rows.previous: Previous edition: 'for European Digital Identity Wallet providers at least EUR 10 million or 2 %'
rows.finding: Article 16 knows only ONE framework: EUR 5 000 000, or, where the provider is a legal person, EUR 5 000 000 or 1 % of the total worldwide turnover of the preceding financial year - whichever is higher, applying to qualified AND non-qualified TSPs. The figures of EUR 10 million / 2 % come from the NIS-2 Directive.

rows.subject: Electronic attestation of attributes in public services
rows.previous: Previous edition: 'shall accept qualified EAAs'
rows.finding: Article 45c is primarily a PROHIBITION: PID in an EAA shall NOT substitute electronic identification and its authentication - unless the Member State specifically allows it. Only then does acceptance of QEAAs from other Member States follow.

rows.subject: Number of definitions
rows.previous: Previous edition: 'approximately 55 definitions'
rows.finding: The numbering runs from point (1) to point (57), supplemented by inserted letter-numbers such as 5a, 16a and 21a. Now stated precisely instead of estimated.

rows.subject: Minimum list of attributes
rows.previous: Previous edition: incomplete list, 'marital status', 'tax and social security numbers'
rows.finding: Annex VI contains eleven items; item 4 reads 'civil status'; item 10 is public permits and licences, item 11 financial and company data for legal persons. Tax and social security numbers are not mentioned in the wording.

rows.subject: Number of mandatory contents
rows.previous: Previous edition: points (a) to (i)
rows.finding: Both Annexes contain points (a) to (j). Point (i) (indication of the validity status) was recast by eIDAS 2.0.

rows.subject: Start of the deadline for provision of the European Digital Identity Wallet
rows.previous: Previous edition: no deadline named
rows.finding: 24 months after the entry into force of the implementing acts under Article 5a(23) AND Article 5c(6) - both shall be in force.

rows.subject: Obligation of private relying parties to accept
rows.previous: Previous edition: without a deadline and without the SME exemption
rows.finding: 36 months after the entry into force of the same implementing acts; microenterprises and small enterprises as defined in Recommendation 2003/361/EC are exempt; acceptance takes place only upon the voluntary request of the user.

rows.subject: Supervision of QTSPs
rows.previous: Previous edition: only the 24-month audit and the 3-working-day deadline
rows.finding: Added: paragraph 1a (advance information one month beforehand and the supervisory body's right to participate as an observer), paragraph 1b (notification of the CAB together with its accreditation), paragraphs 3a/3b (withdrawal of qualified status for NIS2 and GDPR infringements); the scope of the audit includes Article 21 NIS-2.

rows.subject: Verification of identity and attributes
rows.previous: Previous edition: one common list of methods
rows.finding: eIDAS 2.0 separates paragraph 1a (identity, four methods) and paragraph 1b (attributes, five methods including QEAA). Also added were the letter gap at (j) and the 24-hour deadlines in paragraph 2, point (fb) and paragraph 3.

rows.subject: Interoperability
rows.previous: Previous edition: only a reference to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2015/1501
rows.finding: Added: paragraph 3, point (c) (privacy and security by design, new in eIDAS 2.0), paragraphs 5/6 (peer review, implementing act deadline 18 March 2025), paragraph 8 (new interoperability framework, deadline 18 September 2025). Paragraph 7 was deleted.

rows.subject: PuB-EAA
rows.previous: Previous edition: only Annex VII and the qualified electronic seal
rows.finding: Added: paragraph 2 (level of reliability in accordance with Article 24), paragraph 3 (notification with a conformity assessment report - the audit-relevant core), paragraph 8 (obligation to provide an interface with European Digital Identity Wallets).

rows.subject: Prohibition on combining data
rows.previous: Previous edition: 'data from the provider's own other services'
rows.finding: The wording also covers services of the provider's COMMERCIAL PARTNERS.

rows.subject: Deleted Articles
rows.previous: not covered in the previous edition
rows.finding: Included as a row of its own in order to explain the gap in numbering: Articles 17, 18 and 19 were repealed by eIDAS 2.0; their successors are Articles 46b, 46d and 19a.

rows.subject: Validity period of certifications
rows.previous: not covered in the previous edition
rows.finding: Newly included: up to five years, provided that a vulnerability assessment is carried out every two years. Article 12a(3) additionally names a remediation period of three months. For QSCDs (Article 30(3a)) this time limit is new in eIDAS 2.0.

rows.subject: Interoperability between ERDS providers
rows.previous: not covered in the previous edition
rows.finding: New in eIDAS 2.0: providers may agree on an interoperability framework; its conformity is confirmed by a conformity assessment body.

rows.subject: Map of roles
rows.previous: 16 roles in the previous edition
rows.finding: Extended by: the designated body under Article 30 (to be distinguished from the CAB), the operator of the authentication procedure, intermediaries/identity brokers under Article 5b(10), the NIS2 authority and the data protection supervisory authority. ENISA entry corrected: the link runs via Regulation (EU) 2019/881, not via Article 46c.

rows.subject: Paragraph-level detail for Chapter II and Chapter III
rows.previous: in the previous edition only Article 8
rows.finding: Complete analysis by paragraph and point for Chapter II (Articles 5a-12b) and Chapter III (Articles 13-45l) with addressee, modality, purpose, deadline, cross-references, audit question and mnemonic for each row.

rows.subject: Calendar of deadlines
rows.previous: not present
rows.finding: All dates and deadlines in the Regulation in chronological order - one-off cut-off dates and recurring obligations shown separately.

rows.subject: Mirror image of electronic signature / electronic seal
rows.previous: not present
rows.finding: Comparison of the Article pairs 25/35 through 34/40, with explicit marking of the points at which the mirroring does NOT apply.

rows.subject: Flashcards
rows.previous: not present
rows.finding: 43 question-and-answer cards with Article reference and difficulty level for self-testing. The answer column can be hidden for revision.

rows.subject: Reading guide and progress
rows.previous: not present
rows.finding: Legend of the modalities and priorities, list of abbreviations, operating instructions and a progress evaluation with formulas over the status column of the master sheet.
